spans.text: Mecite animations are chunks of mecite that have absorbed enough memories that they gained sentience and formed a body capable of hunting and attacking. Without understanding their purpose or origin, these aberrations seek out groups of sapient creatures and aim to harvest more memories. Their bodies naturally produce amniatic miasma.

When a mecite animation is around beasts that have lost themselves to amniasis, those creatures become connected to the golem and heed its subliminal commands. It innately understands the capabilities of all creatures that have fallen under its sway.
The mecite animation doesn’t require air, food, drink, or sleep.

“I love history. I want to be part of it when I’m gone. I want people to tell my stories and dance with memories of me in their minds. It motivates me to imagine that a stray thought of my time with someone might bring a momentary smile to their lips.

There are no greater horrors than the amniatic beasts that steal that from us. We are what was; I will one day have been. Nothing should take that away.”
